EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a strong aliphatic C–H stretch envelope (2881–2967 cm⁻¹) with vinylic =CH stretching in the 3048–3124 cm⁻¹ region, a strong C=C band near 1639/1614 cm⁻¹ consistent with an alkene (conjugated to a carbonyl), and characteristic out-of-plane vinylic C–H deformation near 972 cm⁻¹ (trans-CH=CH wag), with additional vinyl-related modes around 915–944 cm⁻¹. CH bending bands at ~1466 and 1323 cm⁻¹ further support an aliphatic unsaturated chain (GFQ-003). These features fit an α,β-unsaturated thioester like candidate 1, while NH/OH stretches expected for several other candidates are absent.
